title: Expert Tiering on Unified Memory: Running a 188 GB Mixture-of-Experts Model on a 128 GB GPU Workstation
description: Code, benchmark harness, analysis scripts and run logs of the paper Expert Tiering on Unified Memory: Running a 188 GB Mixture-of-Experts Model on a 128 GB GPU Workstation: a single-copy expert tier for the Strata inference engine (patches against Strata 0.1.27) that runs the 188 GB Q8_0 quantization of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a 128 GB NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10), the microbenchmarks that characterize GB10's memory and storage paths, and the cross-model routing-locality study. The routing traces and other bulky data are in a separate dataset record.
